stages.prompt: Revise only the technical design, API contract, data model, architecture note, or implementation-plan artifacts requested by the supplied PR review feedback. Do not implement product code unless the repository stores the design beside code and the edit is necessary to update that artifact. Preserve unrelated work, keep the change scoped, and produce a concise one-line pr-title artifact that names the design rework.

stages.command: git diff --check && pnpm run check && pnpm run build

stages.prompt: Review the technical-design rework against the triggering review feedback. Check that the updated design resolves the feedback, remains consistent with the approved spec, and gives implementation enough actionable detail. Do not modify files during review. Write `Review verdict: pass` when there are no P0/P1/blocking findings. Write `Review verdict: fail` when any P0/P1/blocking issue exists, and list P0/P1 findings first.

Reflect on this technical-design rework after the change request has been updated. Review the source feedback, revised design artifacts, specification context, verification output, review output, and change request result. Search existing GitHub issues before creating follow-ups. Create GitHub issues only for actionable non-duplicate improvements. Write a concise reflection artifact listing created issue URLs, duplicates found, non-actions/observations, or a clean result when no actionable improvement remains.
